h: King CND reportedly slams Burna Boy over reconciliation with Davido
p: Content creator King CND has reportedly criticised Burna Boy for making peace with Davido, saying he betrayed VeryDarkMan. The comments come as the feud between VeryDarkMan and Davido continues to trend.
more: VeryDarkMan recently showed a school renovation said to be funded by Burna Boy.
The Davido and VeryDarkMan feud is still generating reactions online.
